title: The Application of Digital Twin Technology in the Development of Intelligent Aquaculture: Status and Opportunities
signal: Reviews digital-twin use in intelligent aquaculture, including integration of environmental and biological observations.
open_aqua_relevance: Supports studying a time-aware aquarium state model, but does not validate Open Aqua's consumer implementation or predictive advantage.
limitations: Review-level evidence
Aquaculture contexts may not transfer to home freshwater tanks

title: Redefining Aquaculture Safety with Artificial Intelligence: Design Innovations, Trends, and Future Perspectives
signal: Maps AI-enabled fish behavior recognition and health-monitoring directions in aquaculture safety.
open_aqua_relevance: Motivates future multimodal observation while reinforcing that safety claims require bounded evidence and human verification.
limitations: Review/future-perspective scope
Does not establish safe diagnosis for home aquariums

title: A Review on the Use of Computer Vision and Artificial Intelligence for Fish Recognition, Monitoring, and Management
signal: Surveys growing use of computer vision and AI for fish recognition, monitoring and management.
open_aqua_relevance: Provides a landscape for future behavior/image experiments, not permission to diagnose disease or identify individuals in V0.
limitations: Heterogeneous studies and datasets
Image performance is sensitive to lighting, occlusion and water conditions

title: Advancing Fisheries Research and Management with Machine Learning: A Review
signal: Reviews machine-learning applications and their applicability to fish classification, detection and management.
open_aqua_relevance: Useful for method selection and limitation tracking after Open Aqua has a dataset large enough to justify ML.
limitations: Broad fisheries scope
Method availability is not evidence of value in a single-tank small-data setting

title: Fine-Grained Fish Individual Recognition in Underwater Environments
signal: Reports a computer-vision direction for fine-grained individual fish recognition under underwater conditions.
open_aqua_relevance: Creates a future research option for individual baselines, subject to strong accuracy, welfare, privacy and product-value gates.
limitations: Study context may not match diverse ornamental tanks
Open Aqua explicitly excludes Fish Passport/ownership features

title: Predicting the Body Weight of Tilapia Fingerlings from Images Using Computer Vision
signal: Reports image-based weight prediction for tilapia fingerlings in a defined study context.
open_aqua_relevance: Signals that non-contact longitudinal measurements may be possible, but biomass estimation is not a V0 owner problem.
limitations: Species- and setup-specific
No evidence of transfer to mixed ornamental aquariums

title: Non-Linear Analyses of Fish Behaviours in Response to Environmental Stressors
signal: Examines fish behavior as an indirect response signal under environmental stressor conditions.
open_aqua_relevance: Motivates behavior as corroborating evidence, never as a single-cause diagnosis.
limitations: Indirect signal with multiple competing explanations
Requires independently defined event labels

title: Shellfish as Biosensors in Online Monitoring of Aquatic Ecosystems
signal: Reviews biological organisms as online sentinels of aquatic environmental change.
open_aqua_relevance: Broadens the long-horizon observability thesis beyond chemical probes while remaining outside current freshwater V0 scope.
limitations: Shellfish-specific literature
Not a direct consumer-aquarium implementation path

title: Smart Aquaculture Platform
signal: OceanStar publicly claims 30-second multi-parameter monitoring, cross-parameter ML, advance warning, reporting and rule-based equipment control for RAS facilities.
open_aqua_relevance: Confirms a commercial RAS narrative adjacent to Open Aqua's research thesis, while targeting a different customer and safety envelope.
limitations: Vendor-controlled claims
No independent deployment, accuracy, customer or outcome evidence reviewed here
Commercial RAS is not the home freshwater segment

title: Industrial-Grade Sensors for Aquaculture
signal: OceanStar publicly describes an ESP32-based hub, RS-485/Modbus sensors, Wi-Fi/LTE connectivity and relay outputs for industrial RAS.
open_aqua_relevance: Provides an adjacent industrial reference for interfaces, provenance and reliability questions; it does not define V0 hardware requirements.
limitations: Vendor specifications not independently verified
Industrial price, power and maintenance envelope differs from home experiments

title: From Land-Based Farming to Offshore Marine Ranches: Digital-Twin Directions
signal: Describes coupling environmental dynamics, equipment behavior and fish-school state in digital-twin models for larger aquaculture systems.
open_aqua_relevance: Supports long-horizon cross-scale research while emphasizing that large-system models are not evidence for household aquariums.
limitations: Marine/offshore context
Future-scale adjacency, not V0 product evidence
